results.rationale: A red line is added but crosses several green walls and stops near the center rather than reaching the flowers, so it is not a valid maze route. Instruction failure implies knowledge invalid. The maze and flowers persist but the girl is shifted right onto the entrance. The interrupted, wall-crossing route is a clear semantic flaw in an otherwise legible illustration.

The plant's leaf arrangement, braided trunk and woven pot remain consistent. The green gradient, halo and floating droplets achieve the poster concept, but the title reads 'Green Hople' rather than 'Green Home' and distinct leaf silhouettes are absent. The malformed title is a clear text flaw; the plant and decorative bubbles otherwise retain coherent forms.
